title: Kinetic Press clarity-first product roadmap v2
summary: Perfect the gold equation reader first; promote its shared contracts only after visual approval; then prove geometric, graphical, code, provider, review, and cross-domain breadth.

sourceRefs.intent: Aim first at transferring the loved x + 3 = 7 motion into the semantic reader, with motion as core content and a durable path to beautiful cards, providers, multiple content types, and flashcards.
sourceRefs.summary: Current approved product priority and preservation boundary.
Existing narrative product roadmap retained as historical and strategic context.
Existing product strategy and differentiation context.

planRevision.objective: Deliver visually beautiful, scrollable, searchable, URL-addressable semantic cards whose coordinated motion makes Kinetic Press's value proposition instantly distinct from static text, video, and conventional interactive lessons.

assumptions.statement: One canonical equation card must establish visual and motion quality before renderer breadth is valuable.
The accepted editor realization can be extracted behind neutral renderer contracts without coupling the semantic reader to the editor.
Reduced motion should retain essential explanatory movement while removing nonessential acceleration, depth, scale, and flourish; fully static presentation remains explicit.
Visual parity can be reached without sacrificing static prose, search, print, no-JavaScript output, exact scroll navigation, or precise URLs.

phases.title: Gold equation reader parity
phases.objective: Match the accepted x + 3 = 7 card in the semantic reader at named forward and reverse frames, preserve reader strengths, add essential reduced motion, and stop for human visual approval.

phases.title: Missing-middle algebra and geometry
phases.objective: Use the approved renderer contracts to coordinate algebraic symbols with a simple geometric representation as the second clarity exemplar.

phases.title: SVG diagrams and graphs
phases.objective: Prove stylistically unified lightweight diagrams and graphs, including KaTeX-compatible labeling and shared focus and salience affordances.

phases.title: Code transformation card
phases.objective: Prove modal flexibility with collapsing, morphing, and refactoring code while preserving semantic identity and reviewability.

phases.title: Providers and review modes
phases.objective: Compose verified problem generators, LLM providers, flashcards, and correction workflows around stable semantic card and transformation contracts.

phases.title: Cross-domain and WebGL breadth
phases.objective: Demonstrate network, economics, FTC, physics, and lazy WebGL experiences only where their dimensionality materially improves explanation.
